title: sql: remove 'per app' references in sql stats fingerprint cluster seting
body:
Previously, the cluster setting that limits total number of
statement/transaction fingerprints we can store in-memory suggested
it is a limit per application name. However, we no longer have this
limitation since we have move to use atomic package to store total
fingerprint count.

Release note (sql change): Total number of statement/transaction
 fingerprints stored in-memory can be limit using cluster setting
 sql.metrics.max_mem_stmt_fingerprints and
 sql.metrics.max_mem_txn_fingerprints.
